answer_1.quote: We focus on Narrative Story Completion (NSC), a new task setting for story generation... In this work, we propose COINS: a recursive model that jointly learns to i) dynamically generate commonsense inference rules grounded in the context and to ii) perform controlled and coherent story generation.
answer_1.outputs: Missing story sentences and contextualized inference rules

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation in the NSC task we use as metrics Perplexity (indicates fluency of text generation), BLEU-1/2 and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation focusing on the grammaticality and coherence of the generated sentences in their story context. We present the generated sentences to three annotators and ask them to give a preference rating (win, tie, lose) according to the criteria grammaticality and coherence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate each sentence for grammaticality (fluency, readability) and for coherence (logical consistency with story beginning and ending).
